changes.summary: Refresh documentation evidence for the existing Voyage wire subset and add native C# embeddings/reranking with the same normalized behavior. Hosted live traffic remains unverified.

shared_spec.rationale: Adds a provider-specific translation binding for existing buffered embedding/rerank operations. Normalized requests/results, accounting, routing, safety and validation remain governed by the existing shared contracts. No normative specification, released schema, inventory, frozen fixture or expectation is changed; new tests provide provider wire inputs without redefining shared results. No candidate release or qualification is claimed.

implementations.rationale: Refreshes the existing contract documentation and independently exercises the Python Voyage builtin against shared provider-wire inputs; no Python product behavior or model inventory expansion is proposed.

Adds native Voyage translation, independent handler controls and public packaged consumers. This declaration supplies scope and gate requirements, never run outcomes, hosted verification or a full-library parity claim.
